security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The external-command flags are Markdown fences around text examples, and the blocker flags are advertising terms or headings rather than system reconnaissance. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Markdown fences were misclassified as executable backticks.
remediation.suggestion: Add language labels such as text to fenced examples, or convert simple templates to bullets to reduce scanner noise.

remediation.issue: The opening role statement says the assistant has direct access to ad platform accounts.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that the skill provides planning guidance and uses only account data supplied by the user.

content.value_statement: Paid media teams need clear campaign plans, ad copy, audiences, and optimization steps. This skill turns campaign goals into practical paid advertising guidance across major platforms.
actual_capabilities: Recommends ad platforms based on goals, audience, offer, and budget.
Creates campaign structures with objectives, audiences, ad sets, and naming conventions.
Drafts search and social ad copy using proven messaging frameworks.
Suggests targeting options for Google, Meta, LinkedIn, X, and TikTok.
Provides optimization actions for CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, fatigue, and bid strategy.
Builds setup checklists for conversion tracking, pixels, audiences, and UTM usage.
limitations: Does not connect to ad accounts or make campaign changes directly.
Requires user-provided goals, budget, offer, audience, and performance data.
Cannot guarantee CPA, ROAS, reach, or conversion outcomes.
Platform policies and targeting options may change and should be verified before launch.

use_cases.title: Launch a First Campaign
use_cases.description: Choose the right platform, objective, budget split, and campaign structure for a new offer.

use_cases.title: Improve Paid Media Performance
use_cases.description: Diagnose high CPA, low CTR, ad fatigue, and weak conversion rates using structured optimization steps.

use_cases.title: Plan B2B Audience Targeting
use_cases.description: Define LinkedIn, Google, and retargeting audiences using roles, industries, company traits, and funnel stage.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: I sell [product] to [audience] with a monthly budget of [budget]. Recommend the best ad platform and campaign objective.

prompt_templates.title: Build Campaign Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign structure for [platform] to promote [offer]. Include campaign names, audiences, ad sets, budget split, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Write Ad Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Write paid ad copy for [offer] aimed at [audience]. Include search headlines, social primary text, CTAs, and three creative angles.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Performance Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this campaign performance: [metrics]. Find likely causes, prioritize fixes, and create a seven-day optimization plan.

output_examples.input: A SaaS company wants demo requests from marketing leaders with a limited LinkedIn budget.
output: Recommended platform: LinkedIn for precise B2B targeting, with retargeting on Meta if traffic volume supports it.
Campaign structure: one lead generation campaign, two job seniority audiences, and three ad concepts tied to the demo offer.
Primary metric: cost per qualified demo request, with form completion rate and lead quality reviewed weekly.

output_examples.input: A Meta campaign has high CPM, low CTR, and no conversions after five days.
output: Likely issues: narrow audience, weak creative fit, or unclear offer.
Next steps: expand targeting, test new hooks, check landing page speed, and pause poor performers after enough spend.
Measurement: track CTR, landing page view rate, CPA, and frequency before scaling.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce brand needs retargeting ideas for cart abandoners and product page visitors.
output: Segment hot audiences by cart abandonment within seven days and product views within thirty days.
Use urgency only when genuine, and exclude recent purchasers from all retargeting sets.
Test proof, offer, and objection-handling messages before increasing budget.

best_practices: Start with clear conversion tracking, budget pacing, and a defined success metric.
Test one major variable at a time so results are easier to interpret.
Compare platform-reported results with analytics data and blended acquisition costs.
anti_patterns: Launching campaigns before pixels, conversion events, and UTM parameters are verified.
Spreading a small budget across too many campaigns, audiences, or creative concepts.
Scaling spend before the campaign has enough conversion data and stable performance.

faq.question: Which ad platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, display, retargeting, and related paid media planning.

faq.question: Can it manage my ad account directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides strategy, copy, targeting, and optimization guidance based on information you provide.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Share your offer, audience, budget, goal, target CPA or ROAS, landing page, and any current performance data.

faq.question: Can it write ad copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft headlines, primary text, CTAs, creative angles, and platform-specific copy variations.

faq.question: Can it help diagnose poor campaign performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, frequency, and conversion rate to suggest fixes.

faq.question: Does it replace platform policy review?
faq.answer: No. Review current ad platform rules, regulated category limits, and brand compliance before launching campaigns.
